answer: Each identity’s standing is an oasis whose waters only spread when its work echoes: a piece of work counts only when distinct, unconnected identities independently attest to it, reference it, or build on it, so the echo of real work travels far. An umber of trust grows only from echoes that reach new corners of the network, and a fake’s work has an echo distance of zero — nobody references it, nobody builds on it, so a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing: each fake must produce work that strangers independently find useful, one echo at a time.
